But memberOnlyProcedure is only applied to: tasks (create/update/delete/complete/bulkUpdate), docs (create/update/delete), notifications.create, members.revoke. RLS does provide workspace isolation (JWT app_metadata.workspace_id check) so cross-workspace IDOR is blocked - a guest in Test Workspace cannot access Neodev Studio data. But within their workspace, role-based access control is completely missing at the tRPC layer because ctx.admin bypasses RLS.
